messages:
paul: Short UX question: onboarding checklist currently shows all steps expanded by default. Proposal: collapse to progressive disclosure so first-run users see only top 3 steps + a 'Show all' link. Would that help focus or hide useful context?

sara: Progressive disclosure should help reduce cognitive load. But we risk users not noticing the Sample Projects step if it's collapsed. Maybe pin the sample step as always visible?

kevin: If we pin sample step, it becomes the de facto hero. Is that okay? Research shows samples drive activation so pinning might be fine.

jo: I'm worried about discoverability of settings like "Connect repos" if we collapse too aggressively. Could we have inline short summaries for collapsed steps (one line) so users know what they'll get? e.g., "Sample projects — try a demo or use your repos"

paul: Good idea. One-line summary + primary CTA visible. That keeps focus and keeps discoverability.

a11y-bot: accessibility note: collapsed regions must expose the control with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Also ensure the 'Show all' link is keyboard-focusable and screen-reader friendly: text should be 'Show all onboarding steps' not just 'Show all'.

sara: Copy tweak for sample CTA: current 'Try a sample project' is verbose on mobile. Suggest 'Run demo' as primary and 'Use my repos' as secondary.

kevin: Microcopy for privacy when showing user repos: we should say "We only read repo names and language tags. No code is uploaded." Keep it under 120 chars.

jo: Interaction flow: when user clicks 'Use my repos' open a small bottom sheet with connect button. Avoid interrupting main flow with full modal. Accessibility: bottom sheet must trap focus.

paul: Visual: collapsed step should show a tiny thumbnail or avatar for the sample to hint at content. But thumbnails need alt text. Use alt like 'Preview of sample UI showing search results'.

a11y-bot: Image alt must be descriptive and not just 'screenshot'. Also provide longdesc link in the drawer for complex visuals if needed. Color contrast: small language pills at 11px fail AA; increase to 13px semibold or use darker bg.

sara: Dev constraints: lazy-load thumbnails to save bandwidth. On mobile, only load when expanded.

kevin: Metrics question: how do we measure whether progressive disclosure improves activation? We should track open rates for the sample step, demo runs, and opt-ins for repo connect.

paul: Agreed. Events to add: onboarding.step.toggled, onboarding.sample.run, onboarding.repos.optin. No repo names in payloads.

jo: Quick vote: pin sample step visible by default + collapsed other steps with one-line summaries. React with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no, :thinking_face: for need more research.

paul: Done: created tiny poll: https://poll.company/ux/321 (expires 48h)

sara: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

a11y-bot: reminder: add keyboard guidance copy near the 'Show all' control for discoverability.

jo: Action items: 1) Sara - update copy for collapsed summaries + CTAs 2) Kevin - lazy-load thumbnail spec + badge contrast 3) Paul - add telemetry hooks to onboarding epic and create experiment flag for progressive disclosure 4) Jo - update accessibility checklist with aria attributes and focus flow. I'll link updated comps later. Thanks team! :sparkles:
